unknowns: Which key, joystick button or mouse control actually fires which command in the running game, what the original does while text is entered and what it does on focus loss are runtime questions; they need an owner-supplied original run (task #358 REF-OWNER-FIRST-CAPTURE).

The default rows are static code evidence: each registration call's arguments were decoded from the image bytes, but the binding encoding itself (which argument is key A, the 11-bit modifier layout, the modifier-matching rule that a plain key is ignored when a modified combination of it is bound, and the per-slot uniqueness rule) is the owner's static analysis, not a runtime observation.

The joystick axis mapping (X to roll inverted, Y to pitch, Z or slider 0 to the throttle, Rz to rudder inverted, hat to the look commands) and the FlyMode input-mode flags (0 to 1, 1 to 3, 2 to 5) are the owner's static analysis over 0x487460 and 0x440500; the temporary in-flight remap of commands 1 and 2 (0x450550/0x450e30) is recorded but not exercised.

The project's own default map is unchanged and stays designed: the comparison in bindings.json records where the two defaults differ, and none of the original's bindings was wired into the flight path.
